title: Grateful Dead Live at University of Virginia on 1982-09-14
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/96k) ->Samplitude Professional v11.2.1 -> FLAC/24
source: AKG 414 -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/Maxell XLII-S/TDK MA-R)

ai_review.summary: Good audience capture of a classic ’82 show with a smoking Supplication and vibrant second set, but the venue boom is audible.
ai_review.review: The recording faithfully reproduces the U‑Hall atmosphere, crowd mood and acoustics, giving listeners a true sense of being there. Musically the performance shines – a nine‑minute “Supplication”, adventurous “Birdsong” and a strong second set rank among the year’s highlights. The audio is generally clear and lively, though a low‑frequency boom from the hall can be distracting; a pure soundboard source would be cleaner.

ai_rating.rationale: Show is praised for strong musical moments and high energy, while recording is deemed good but with noticeable venue boom; limited number of reviews yields medium confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear overall capture of crowd and room ambience, but a pronounced low‑frequency boom from the venue detracts slightly from clarity.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set mixes up tempos and improvisations, ranking among the top shows of 1982.
